retainedEvidence.measures: Private restrictive staging and safe archive extraction. No traversal/absolute/device/FIFO/socket hazards. Explicit symlink, hard-link, and sparse rules. Extracted tree equals the signed full-tree path/type/mode/length/digest closure.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform (filesystem axis UNPOPULATED; this member does not quantify over an undefined filesystem set), a digest-pinned hostile-archive input, the staging-root identity, the extracted tree as path/type/mode/length/digest, and a typed refusal record for each file-04 hazard class (traversal, absolute, device, FIFO, socket, escaping symlink, hostile hard-link, sparse-as-full). Each extracted file sha256 equals the signed TreeCommitment entry. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Extracted bytes equal verified TreeCommitment bytes. Hazard classes refuse. Staging is private and restrictive. This member does not score G15 AT-8 / AT-ARCHIVE-* adapter archive-profile identity.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: hostile archive corpus class. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: File-04 case/Unicode/link aliases on the executed tree. Live schemas.v11 pathRule uniqueness (relative, forward-slash, NFC-composed, case-sensitively unique AND unique under case-folding and Unicode normalization; no '.' or '..'; no leading '/'; no drive letters; no backslashes; no NUL; no empty segments; symlink targets resolve inside the tree). Admission identity of presented manifest/index/lock bytes remains sha256 of stored bytes. D-161 / OBL-UNICODE-NORM records pathRule / RJ-3 BLOCKED for the Unicode-norm-duplicate class pending a schemas successor; this member does not score that admission class.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform (filesystem axis UNPOPULATED; this member does not quantify over an undefined filesystem set), extracted/executed path-identity records showing that case/Unicode/link aliases cannot resolve to different bytes than the verified tree, plus refusal records for pathRule violations at extract/exec on the limbs pathRule / RJ-3 can score. This member consumes pathRule / RJ-3 for those scorable limbs. D-161 / OBL-UNICODE-NORM records pathRule / RJ-3 BLOCKED for the Unicode-norm-duplicate class pending a schemas successor. The executed-tree Unicode-alias limb (two filesystem Unicode aliases cannot execute different bytes than the verified tree) is independently scorable without that successor. The pathRule / RJ-3 Unicode-norm-duplicate refusal class waits on that successor and remains OBL-UNICODE-NORM on DR-103; this member does not score it. This member does not author the DR-103 unicode-norm-duplicate fixture. It does not author Windows-only TC-PATH. It invents no JSON canonicalization (ID-DEP-1 remains the signing-preimage owner; encodingRule forbids admission canonicalization). Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Two aliases (case, Unicode, or link) cannot execute different bytes than the verified tree. pathRule violations on scorable limbs refuse as executed-tree identity failure. D-161 / OBL-UNICODE-NORM records pathRule / RJ-3 BLOCKED for the Unicode-norm-duplicate class pending a schemas successor; this member does not score that class. The executed-tree Unicode-alias limb is independently scorable without that successor. OBL-UNICODE-NORM and OBL-WINDOWS-PATH remain on DR-103.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: hostile path corpus class. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: Descriptor/identity/open-handle or digest recheck that binds verification to spawn. Entrypoint and runtime-library resolution inside the verified tree. No PATH, loader, shell, live-project, system-runtime, or install-time substitution. Loader and entrypoint replacement.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform (filesystem axis UNPOPULATED; this member does not quantify over an undefined filesystem set; the same qualifier as EV-1, EV-2, and EV-4), the signed TreeCommitment entry set for the platform under test (per-entry path/type/mode/length/digest; not a single treeRootDigest), the held descriptor or open-handle identity or digest-recheck record from verification through spawn (the digest recheck is tree-scoped: every spawned in-tree path, including the entrypoint and every resolved in-tree runtime library, is rechecked against the signed TreeCommitment), the executed entrypoint path and digest, the resolved in-tree runtime-library set as path/type/mode/length/digest pinned to TreeCommitment entries, and the refusal record when PATH/loader/shell/live-project/system-runtime/install-time substitution or loader/entrypoint replacement would execute different bytes. File 04 permits descriptor/identity/open-handle or digest recheck; a held pathname descriptor is not by itself an immutable snapshot (TCB v45). G22 / DR-126 full loader traces witness declared platform TCB / system-class resolution (OS ABI, loader, libc, framework, cert, font, ICU, comparable system-class). They are not this member's in-tree runtime-library limb. This member retains the in-tree resolution evidence here. Fixtures are unauthored. This member does not retain a singular tree-root digest. schemas.v11 treeRootDigest stays reserved (RJ-6). This member does not invent a section 7.1 recipe.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Spawned bytes equal verified bytes. Every resolved in-tree runtime library matches a TreeCommitment entry. Loader or entrypoint replacement that changes executed identity refuses. G22 retained loader traces witness declared platform TCB / system-class resolution, not this member's in-tree runtime-library limb.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: hostile loader corpus class. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: Directory/inode swaps, concurrent update/remove, and TOCTOU across supported platforms/filesystems, including verify-to-spawn.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per D-002 platform (filesystem axis UNPOPULATED; this member does not quantify over an undefined filesystem set), race records at extract, canonicalize, verify-to-spawn, and concurrent update/remove, including directory/inode swap between verification and spawn. Each record pins pre-image identity, post-image identity, and the typed outcome (execute the still-verified identity, or refuse). No wall-clock threshold is invented. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: A race that would execute unverified bytes refuses or remains bound to the still-verified identity. Pass all four platforms; waiver requires platform removal.
